answer: Hired twins once drained a desert canteen by reusing one stamp. Now an oasis grants a single fill per shift: the applicant drives a labeled anchor peg into a numbered trough, posts 52 units, and commits P=blake2s(peg_no||shift_id||pubkey||solar_bin) ahead of the zenith bell. Six well scribes unseal the commitment and replay the gnomon strip; funds return after 14 hours only when that peg_no is unique. If two keys claim one peg or one shift, both deposits are forfeit and the peg is struck from the board, so each extra mouth costs more than the water it might steal.
